help_cmd_autorole.text: /autorole <role_id> — automatically give a role to all members

help_cmd_backup.text: /backup — get a backup of the database

help_cmd_banlink.text: /banlink <link or code> — add a link or invite code to the banned list

help_cmd_dm.text: /dm <text> — set the DM text sent before a ban ({{server}} — server name)

help_cmd_force_leave.text: /force_leave <server_id> — remove the bot from a server

help_cmd_globalban.text: /globalban <user_id> <reason> <duration> — ban on this server and across the whole network (duration: 1h, 1d, 2m=months, 3y=years, infinity=10 years)

help_cmd_globalunban.text: /globalunban <user_id> — lift a network ban and unban on the network's servers

help_cmd_guard.text: /guard <duration> <reason> — enable spam guard in this channel

help_cmd_list_chats.text: /list_chats — list of servers the bot runs on

help_cmd_loc_compare.text: /loc-compare <code> — compare a reply's translations across languages

help_cmd_loc_reply.text: /loc-reply <code> <text> — reply to a localization suggestion (bot admins)

help_cmd_locale.text: /locale [code] — localization status or the file of the chosen language

help_cmd_localizer_add.text: /localizer-add <user> — grant Localizer status: localization editing via the control panel (bot admins)

help_cmd_localizer_rem.text: /localizer-rem <user> — revoke a delegated Localizer status (bot admins)

help_cmd_remadmin.text: /remadmin <user_id> — revoke a user's server admin status

help_cmd_remconsul.text: /remconsul <user_id> — revoke a user's consul status on the appeal server (bot admins)

help_cmd_setappeal.text: /setappeal <text> — text appended on a new line to the ban message

help_cmd_setconsul.text: /setconsul <user_id> — appoint a user as a consul on the appeal server (bot admins)

help_cmd_setgbans.text: /setgbans <enable|disable> — enable/disable enforcement of network bans on this server

help_cmd_setup.text: /setup <language> <channel_id> [network] — register the server: language, log channel, network

help_cmd_setverify.text: /setverify <role_id> [channel_id] — give a role to members who have been active for more than one day (database shared by all servers)

help_cmd_unban.text: /unban <user_id> — unban a user by ID on this server

help_cmd_unbanlink.text: /unbanlink <number> — remove a link from the banned list (the number is in /links)
